Call-attempt tags 1/3, 2/3 and 3/3 (24 orders) are read into Orders_Master!O as confirm_attempts.  CONFIRMED by Omar 28 Aug 2026: these are confirmation-call attempts, the same convention as the 2/2 entries in the old call log.  Treat the column as reliable.

KPI RULES agreed 28 Aug 2026:  denominator = ALL orders placed.  Whappi outcomes are reported as their own segment, never credited to or deducted from Hadeer.  An order tagged "confirmed omar" sits OUTSIDE Hadeer's numerator and INSIDE her denominator - it is a miss, because she did not get to it.
14  FULFILMENT CHANNELS  -  Bosta is not the whole business.  Never merged, same rule as the three return channels.
Its own. Customer collects in person; no courier leg exists.
Delivery KPIs. This is what v1.0 and v2.0 measured.

FOURTH CHANNEL, INFERRED - "Pickup - unrecorded".  An order that is paid, not cancelled, carries no Bosta shipment and was not booked as "90 Office" was almost certainly collected from the store and nobody changed its status.  Confirmed by Omar on order #7344, 28 Aug 2026.  These are held SEPARATE from measured pickups and are never folded into the no-show rate - the outcome is inferred from payment, not recorded.  The fix belongs at source: set the shipping method to "90 Office" when a customer collects.
15  PICKUP AGEING  -  Omar's policy, set 28 Aug 2026.  Not a sourced benchmark.
Amber. Customer has had three days to walk in.
Red. Cancel and release the stock.
The most recent order in the export. Ageing is measured to the data, not to today, so a stale paste cannot silently inflate the ages.
An order placed in the last N days of the export may simply not have reached Bosta yet. Inside this window it is never inferred to be a store pickup.

Baseline before this rule existed: four pickup orders were cancelled in one manual sweep on 1 Aug 2026 at 21:31, aged 32 to 43 days.  Four more were sitting 35 to 48 days old and still open at the 17 Aug cut.

FALSE ALARM RECORDED: RAW_Bosta is NOT incomplete

An early read called the 18-28 Jun period a missing-data gap. Wrong. RAW_Bosta and RAW_Costs carry identical 237 tracking numbers, Bosta never billed for the absent orders, and Shopify financial status predicts the Bosta outcome (131/131 delivered = paid, 66/77 RTO = voided). The period is a Bosta onboarding ramp, not lost rows. Recorded so nobody re-opens it.
